newsitem.title: USA: Total Research cuts costs, revamps.
newsitem.headline: Total Research cuts costs, revamps.

text.p: Total Research Corp said it has cut $2 million in expenses during this fiscal year which ends June 30, 1997.
The company cut its corporate overhead to five percent of revenues from 10 percent as it eliminated several senior positions, Total Research said.
The international marketing research firm previously said it would not replace its president, Hugh Devine, who retired recently but remains a member of the board of directors.

Total Research said it has streamlined global operations into four divisions: Quality Management & Customer Loyalty; Global Health Care Division; Strategic Marketing Services; and a U.S. Regional Offices Division.
The streamlined structure has combined the operations of some of the company's existing divisions, Total Research said.
